fullContent:
Yashad (Jasad) Bhasma – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ras Tarangini 
 Introduction 
 Yashad (Jasad) Bhasma is an Ayurvedic preparation made from zinc which is helpful in treating eye ailments, asthma, cough, and anemia. It helps in balancing Kapha and pitta. It can be used orally and helps in boosting immunity. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Zinc 
 Aloe Vera juice 
 
 Method Preparation 
 Purify zinc and grind them in a fine powder. Now, put it in an iron pan and let it melt. Add powdered Achyranthes aspera and mix well. Triturate this powder with Aloe Vera juice and form round, flat cakes. Put them in a sealed container and heat it at a temperature of 800- 900 degree Celsius for 5 hours. Repeat the entire process seven times. 
 Dosage 
 125 mg twice daily after meals with honey, Tinospora concoction. 
 Indications 
 
 Eye disorders 
 Diabetes 
 Cold, cough 
 Other respiratory tract infections 
 Wound healing 
 Epilepsy 
 Gonorrhea 
 Urinary disorders 
 Tremors 
 Menorrhagia 
 Night sweating 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage can cause severe gastritis. 
 It should be prescribed by your doctor. Self-medication is strictly discouraged. 
 It should be avoided by pregnant women, lactating mothers and kids. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
